local_patch_description: Preserve pre-cast, pre-materialization latent model state and reload quantizers; admit only declared FP32 latent training sources before loading. See OnQ/docs/CHECKPOINTS.md. Separate frozen inference loading from FP32 latent training admission; materialized evaluation does not requantize weights and keeps the exported FP16 dtype. Reject abbreviated CLI options and incompatible clamp endpoint gradients before Block-AP updates, preserving the upstream quantizer arithmetic. update_dataset runs torch.cuda.empty_cache()/gc.collect() once per pass instead of per batch (bitwise-identical outputs). Package imports renamed from qat to OnQ; quantization arithmetic unchanged. Preserve original two-GPU global-batch-2 execution; reject any nonfinite activation/loss without a debugger and skip absent validation activation caches during disk offload. Remove the identical shadowed clamp_ste definition; the surviving function and all quantization arithmetic are unchanged.
